# Imgkeep

> Imgkeep is a free browser extension for Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Firefox that saves web images as PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or PDF from the right-click menu, and can show an image's colour palette. It converts each image on the user's computer (nothing is uploaded) and saves it to Downloads, a folder the user picks (Chrome and Edge), or wherever they choose each time. It is open source under the MIT licence.

Key facts:

- Use: right-click an image, choose "Imgkeep", then PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF (keeps animation), PDF or Original format. "Copy as PNG" puts the image on the clipboard. "Get colour palette" shows its main colours.
- Colour palette: "Get colour palette" shows an image's 5, 8 or 12 main colours, largest first, with each one's share. Click one to copy it as HEX, RGB or HSL; copy all as CSS variables, Tailwind, JSON or a list; or save a PNG swatch strip, a GIMP palette (.gpl) or Adobe swatches (.ase). Worked out on the device. It also works on images found with Find image here (through More options).
- Converts the WebP and AVIF images many sites now serve into PNG or JPG files that every app opens. Animated WebP can be saved as an animated GIF.
- Privacy: images are converted on the device and never uploaded. No account. One anonymous daily count of which features were used and which saves failed is sent (never images, addresses or file names), and it can be turned off in Options. In Firefox the daily count is off unless the user allows it when Firefox asks at install.
- Find image here: on sites that cover their photos with another layer (like Instagram and Pinterest), a right-click can't reach the image. "Imgkeep: Find image here" looks at that page once, finds the photo under the click at its largest size, and opens it ready to save. Off until the user turns it on.
- Permissions: contextMenus, downloads, storage, offscreen (Chrome and Edge; Firefox doesn't need offscreen). Two optional ones, activeTab and scripting, only if the user turns on Find image here. Imgkeep doesn't read the sites the user visits, except that one page when asked to find an image there, and it never changes a page. If a site blocks an image, Imgkeep asks for access to that one site, only after the user clicks to allow it.
- Price: free, no ads. A paid Imgkeep Pro with extra features is planned; current features stay free.
- Saves one image at a time (the one right-clicked), not every image on a page.
- Works in Google Chrome 116 and newer, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox 140 and newer, in 51 languages. In Firefox, images are saved to Downloads or wherever the user chooses each time, because Firefox can't save into a folder picked in advance.
- Free Image Converter at imgkeep.app/convert/: the same conversion code in a web page, for files already on a computer or phone. No uploads, no sign-up.

## Free Image Converter

- [Free Image Converter](https://imgkeep.app/convert/): converts HEIC (iPhone photos), WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPG, SVG and more to PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, PDF or ICO in the browser. No uploads, no sign-up: images never leave the device, and it works offline once loaded (AVIF output once its encoder has loaded). Each result can be downloaded or copied as a PNG. Free, no ads, open source (same conversion code as the extension).
- [WebP to JPG](https://imgkeep.app/webp-to-jpg/): transparent areas get a background colour (white by default); quality 92 by default.
- [WebP to PNG](https://imgkeep.app/webp-to-png/): keeps transparency; animated WebP becomes one frame (choose GIF to keep motion).
- [AVIF to JPG](https://imgkeep.app/avif-to-jpg/): for apps and upload forms that can't open AVIF.
- [PNG to JPG](https://imgkeep.app/png-to-jpg/): smaller files for photos; choose quality and background colour.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://imgkeep.app/heic-to-jpg/): iPhone photos as JPGs that open on Windows and in upload forms; decoded on the device, nothing uploaded.
- [HEIC to PNG](https://imgkeep.app/heic-to-png/): iPhone photos as lossless PNGs; the HEIC decoder loads only when a photo is added (Safari opens HEIC itself).
- [JPG to PNG converter](https://imgkeep.app/jpg-to-png/): Turn a JPG into a PNG for an app or form that wants PNG, without uploading it.
- [PNG to WebP converter](https://imgkeep.app/png-to-webp/): Make PNG images smaller for your website, transparency kept, without uploading them.
- [AVIF to PNG converter](https://imgkeep.app/avif-to-png/): Open AVIF images in any app: convert them to PNG, transparency kept, without uploading.
- [WebP to GIF converter](https://imgkeep.app/webp-to-gif/): Turn animated WebP into a GIF that keeps moving, for chats and apps that only play GIF.
- [AVIF to GIF converter](https://imgkeep.app/avif-to-gif/): Turn animated AVIF into a GIF that plays everywhere, without uploading it.
- [JFIF to JPG converter](https://imgkeep.app/jfif-to-jpg/): Turn .jfif files into standard .jpg files that every app and upload form accepts, without uploading.
- [JFIF to PNG converter](https://imgkeep.app/jfif-to-png/): Turn .jfif images into PNG files for editors and apps that want PNG, without uploading.
- [JPG to PDF converter](https://imgkeep.app/jpg-to-pdf/): Make a PDF from a photo or scan for a form or an email, without uploading it.
- [PNG to PDF converter](https://imgkeep.app/png-to-pdf/): Turn screenshots, diagrams and graphics into a PDF, transparency kept, without uploading.
- [HEIC to PDF converter](https://imgkeep.app/heic-to-pdf/): Turn iPhone photos of documents, receipts and IDs into PDFs, without uploading them.
- [SVG to PNG converter](https://imgkeep.app/svg-to-png/): Turn an SVG logo or icon into a PNG for apps and sites that can't open SVG, without uploading.
- [JPG to ICO converter](https://imgkeep.app/jpg-to-ico/): Make a favicon or Windows icon from a photo or logo JPG, without uploading.
- [SVG to ICO converter](https://imgkeep.app/svg-to-ico/): Make a sharp favicon or Windows icon from your SVG logo, transparency kept, without uploading.
- [Every conversion](https://imgkeep.app/convert/formats/): the converter's pages, one per format pair.
- [PNG to ICO](https://imgkeep.app/png-to-ico/): one .ico with 16, 32 and 48 px icons, plus 256 px for large images.

## Color palette from image

- [Color palette from image](https://imgkeep.app/color-palette-from-image/): an image's 5, 8 or 12 main colors in the browser, no uploads, no sign-up; copy HEX, RGB, HSL, CSS or Tailwind, or save .ase and .gpl files. Same code as the extension.

## Install

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/fkclfgbmjaafglfifenonfcahfdmajbl)
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/kokbmagcbobpjclpidebikeklmpafhhd)
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/imgkeep/)
- [Download page](https://imgkeep.app/download/): every store link in one place: Chrome Web Store, Microsoft Edge Add-ons and Firefox Add-ons (addons.mozilla.org).

## Guides

- [Why Chrome saves images as WebP](https://imgkeep.app/chrome-saves-images-as-webp/): Chrome saves the file the site sent; many sites send WebP. No setting changes it; convert as you save or afterwards.
- [How to save WebP as JPG or PNG](https://imgkeep.app/save-webp-as-jpg-png/): with an extension in one step, or with Paint, Preview or copy and paste. Which format to pick.
- [How to save AVIF as JPG or PNG](https://imgkeep.app/save-avif-as-jpg-png/): what AVIF is, why apps refuse it, and how to convert it.
- [Chrome saves images as JFIF? How to get JPG](https://imgkeep.app/chrome-saves-images-as-jfif/): a .jfif file is a JPEG with a different ending, set by a Windows registry setting; rename it, fix the setting, or save as JPG.
- [How to save an animated WebP as a GIF](https://imgkeep.app/save-animated-webp-as-gif/): keep an animation moving (JPG and PNG keep one frame); what GIF keeps and loses; with an extension or GIMP.
- [How to save an image as a PDF in Chrome](https://imgkeep.app/save-image-as-pdf/): Chrome's print to PDF, Photos or Preview, or a one-page PDF the size of the image from the right-click menu.
- [A safe alternative to Save image as Type](https://imgkeep.app/save-image-as-type-alternative/): why Google removed it in March 2026, and a checklist for judging any image extension.
- [The best Save Image As extensions, compared](https://imgkeep.app/best-save-image-as-extensions/): 13 extensions for Chrome, Edge and Firefox and Imgkeep on the same features, every fact sourced and dated.
- [Imgkeep vs Save webP as PNG or JPEG](https://imgkeep.app/imgkeep-vs-save-webp-as-png-or-jpeg/): the open-source Firefox add-on and Imgkeep side by side, with who should pick which.
- [When right-click won't save an image](https://imgkeep.app/save-image-right-click-not-working/): why some sites cover their photos so the right-click can't reach them, the workarounds (developer tools, a screenshot), and Imgkeep's opt-in Find image here.
- [How to save images from Pinterest](https://imgkeep.app/save-images-from-pinterest/): why right-click fails and how to get the original size.
- [How to save images from Instagram](https://imgkeep.app/save-images-from-instagram/): saving a photo you can see, and downloading your own.
- [How to save images from Google Images](https://imgkeep.app/save-images-from-google-images/): getting the full image, not the thumbnail.
- [How to save images from X (Twitter)](https://imgkeep.app/save-images-from-x-twitter/): the link layer over photos and name=orig for full size.
- [How to save images from Reddit](https://imgkeep.app/save-images-from-reddit/): WebP previews and the full-size i.redd.it file.
- [How to save images from Facebook](https://imgkeep.app/save-images-from-facebook/): covered photos, the photo viewer and your own photos.
- [How to get an image from the web into Canva, Figma or Google Slides](https://imgkeep.app/web-image-into-canva-figma-google-slides/): copy it as a PNG and paste it, or save WebP or AVIF as PNG or JPG when a tool says the file type isn't supported; which formats each tool's help lists.
